page.overview:
Who is Markog?

Markog was a Heretic Astartes Chaos Champion of Slaanesh and the Chaos Lord of the Dolorous Guard warband of Chaos Space Marines who served as the honour guard of Seraphax after they joined the Sorcerer Lord's warhost of the Ten Thousand Eyes. He was slain by a group of former Fallen Angels known as The Risen during the battle between the awakened Primarch Lion El'Jonson and Seraphax on the world of Sable in the Imperium Nihilus.

Markog was originally an officer of the Ashen Blades Chapter of the Adeptus Astartes known for his intense pride. When the Ashen Blades' Chapter fleet was trapped in the Immaterium by the sudden onset of a Warp storm, the Chapter's Space Marines were consumed by infighting as Chaos slowly claimed them. When the survivors finally reemerged into realspace aboard their battle barge Blade of Truth after an unknown subjective amount of time trapped in the Warp, they had become Heretic Astartes commanded by Markog, who was now their Chaos Lord and a Chaos Champion of Slaanesh who had been drawn to the Dark Prince by his pride and ego.

It was Markog who renamed the survivors of the Ashen Blades the Dolorous Guard and eventually brought them to join the warhost of the Ten Thousand Eyes commanded by the Sorcerer Lord Seraphax. Seraphax welcomed the Dolorous Guard, making the Blade of Truth the flagship of his Chaos fleet and naming Markog's warband his honour guard. Markog greatly respected the power of the Sorcerer Lord and gladly followed his every command.

The Chaos Lord was suited to his new role, for as a Slaaneshi Champion he had been gifted the Daemon Axe Heartdrinker by his divine patron. As long as he held the weapon, Markog was able to heal any wound dealt to him and also teleport the Dolorous Guard through the Warp to wherever they needed to be. However, Markog's corruption by the Prince of Chaos had left him with intense cravings to feel the pleasure engendered by consuming Human flesh, especially those of his fellow Astartes.
